svg.title: Korg volca beats overhead wireframe diagram
svg.desc: Schematic top view grouped by panel section. Every physical control has a stable ID and accessible label. Standalone buttons are disabled until a host supplies interaction. MIDI regions match the JSON surface; note and shared parameter regions use the setup described in the profile.
